scope: Six regressions for remaining survivors after v4; full v5 campaign finished and failed

review.contract: Independently corrupted BMLS magic, term count and bit count with recomputed hashes return BlockHeader rather than a later stream error.
Files below 256 bytes return HeaderLength; exactly 256 bytes with invalid magic return Magic.
Seven independently violated section-layout relations return SectionLayout before catalog processing; header hashes are valid and downstream offsets are adjusted to isolate each relation.

For a fixed single-weight model, eight extra retained synthesis bits add one accounted byte, an additional proof slot includes rational scratch, and two extra rational bits add one byte per proof slot.
Writer returns Open for a destination lookup failing through a symlink loop instead of proceeding to temporary creation.
Converter returns the destination Open error before inspecting an intentionally invalid source, preserving source data.

complete_campaign_v5.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations-v5
